name: 273. Provider conversions keep what the wire needs, and refused models never leave the gateway (provider-preservation) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-5539 regression. Local fixture regression: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream: the rows read back the bytes that reached it from /__wire. A restored custom tool is relayed from the typed response, a repeated embedding input embeds the last one, xAI's native Messages are forwarded unchanged but for the model prefix and logged as Anthropic, a Cloudflare decision model cannot leave the decision endpoint, text documents reach Anthropic decoded, Gemini code execution keeps its thought signatures, vision embeddings stay on the multimodal endpoint, a custom Cohere provider gets Cohere's tool_choice default, a Databricks decision with an image asset is refused rather than decided without the image, a compacted tool addition keeps its programmatic caller restriction, and a tool search replay embeds sanitized definitions. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: a custom tool answer is relayed restored, not as its raw function call - provider-preservation

exec: pm.test('provider-preservation setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('the item is the custom_tool_call the client declared', function () { pm.expect(body.output[0].type).to.equal('custom_tool_call'); pm.expect(body.output[0].input).to.equal('*** patch'); });
pm.test('the upstream bytes were not relayed', function () { pm.expect(body.x_fixture_raw, 'x_fixture_raw exists only in the raw body').to.equal(undefined); });

wire(function (calls) { pm.test('the custom tool left the gateway as a function tool', function () { pm.expect(calls).to.have.length(1); pm.expect((JSON.parse(calls[0].body).tools || [{}])[0].type, calls[0].body).to.equal('function'); }); });

item.name: a streamed custom tool answer is relayed restored, not as raw frames - provider-preservation

exec: pm.test('provider-preservation setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, text).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('the stream carries the custom tool input', function () { pm.expect(text).to.include('response.custom_tool_call_input.done'); pm.expect(text).to.include('*** patch'); });
// extra_fields.raw_response repeats the provider's frame on request; what counts is the frame the client acts on.
var types = text.split('\n').filter(function (l) { return l.indexOf('data: {') === 0; }).map(function (l) { return JSON.parse(l.slice(6)).type; });

pm.test('no raw function_call frame reached the client', function () { pm.expect(types).to.include('response.custom_tool_call_input.done'); pm.expect(types).to.not.include('response.function_call_arguments.done'); });

pm.test('sequence numbers stay unique', function () { var seen = {}; text.split('\n').forEach(function (l) { if (l.indexOf('data: {') !== 0) return; var n = JSON.parse(l.slice(6)).sequence_number; pm.expect(seen[n], 'sequence_number ' + n).to.equal(undefined); seen[n] = true; }); });
